issue.body:
### Description
Currently, we do not display histogram data (neither standard nor exponential) in Metrics in Discover at all. To support these field types, we will render them as a 95th percentile (p95) over time.

**This ticket specifically addresses the support for the standard `histogram` field type.**

**Note:** The long-term goal is to render these fields as a Heatmap. However, for this initial step, we will flatten the data into a single number (p95) so existing charting components can render the result without modification.

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] When a time series data stream has metrics of type `histogram` those metrics are visible when querying `TS ${data_stream}`
- [ ] The metric is rendered in the chart as a p95 over time with the following query `TS ${data_stream} | STATS PERCENTILE(TO_TDIGEST(${histogram_metric_name}), 95) BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 100, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
` which contains the casting
   - [ ] And a warning is shown on the metric panel explaining that the data might not be accurate: "Calculated assuming T-Digest encoding. If the histogram was encoded differently, the value is approximate"
- [ ] ~When writing a query to query a `histogram` in the ES|QL bar, `histogram` metrics can be visualized as a p95 over time~ 
   - ~[ ] [TBC] And a warning is shown showing that TO_TDIGEST only shows accurately results if the metric is TDIGEST~ 
   - Created this ticket as it out of the scope of this ticket and we don't own this part https://github.com/elastic/kibana/issues/253048
